The cycle time seems kinda long, but then again the old units cycle time wasn't extremely short either. Was hoping 1 hour cycle would be quicker. Found new positioning of Pots & Pans critical for proper dispersal of soap. As with any new appliance a learning curve will take place.This Dishwasher was highly recommended by more than one appliance sales people! I would recommend this unit also!

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that can be used every day to relieve the pressure of washing dishes for a family of four. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher I used was the Mydia 6-person dishwasher. [You can get a sense of the noise level in the video!] Storage & Structure. Because it's a two-tiered design, it's difficult to load large pots simultaneously because they touch the bottom of the tray. However, it's more than enough for the dishes and utensils left after dinner for a family of four. Washing & Drying. Using the hot air mode, it takes about 140 minutes. After use, the dishes on the upper tray... Water drips from the ceiling, causing a puddle behind the flat dishes. You have to turn the dishes upside down before loading them. I'm very satisfied with the features. There are various wash modes, and the automatic door opening function makes it easy to remove moisture and dry the interior. There are some minor issues with stacked dishes, but since it's just one dish, I can finish by hand. Lifestyle Change. The best part is that I'm freed from the pressure of having to do the dishes. Cooking, plating, and serving dishes for a family of four is no small feat. It's so convenient because all I have to do is rinse, run the dishwasher, and put it away. Usage tip: Rinsing before putting it away is to slow down the buildup of debris, extending the internal cleaning cycle. Thanks to this, I've used significantly less detergent and water, and I'm looking forward to seeing the utility bills in a month. Results: Excellent cleaning power and cleanliness are a given, and putting away warm dishes after drying feels like folding warm cloths. I felt this dishwasher would be highly satisfying for small households, especially families of four.

It's puzzling, however, that the equivalent white model has a discount in the larger promotion (€75), as both start at the same price. We hope it lasts as long as our previous one, also a Bosch model (SGS57M08EU, from 2004), which worked for 22 years and had to be replaced because the racks in the baskets started to rust and, in recent days, the program buttons began to respond erratically. It continued to function and deliver excellent results until the very end. I considered a built-in 12-14-seater dishwasher, but that would require removing the sink cabinets and reducing storage space, which was a concern. And since the price difference is big, visit Coupang often to check and buy. I got it with a credit card discount and paid less than 450,000 won.

Sentence (English): DO NOT BUY FROM MEDIAMARKT!
Comments (English): [ NO COMPRES AND MEDIAMARKT ] || ---------------- || DO NOT BUY FROM MEDIAMARKT! They sometimes have great deals, but their after-sales service is terrible. The dishwasher itself works very well; it cleans very well, even with heavily soiled dishes. The containers on the bottom rack also clean easily, and everything comes out very dry. The problem is that it comes with two side seals that you have to attach yourself with a strip of adhesive that comes pre-attached, which keeps peeling off. I've ordered a new seal (since only one keeps falling off), but they haven't sent me a replacement, so I'm very disappointed. Ultimately, if you run the dishwasher and that seal isn't properly in place, water leaks out because the door doesn't seal completely (a few drops, not a stream, but water does leak). I don't know if it's worth spending so much money considering this issue. Their solution is for me to take the dishwasher to a store and request a refund, which takes more than 15 days, when it would be so easy to just send me a new seal. Furthermore, their customer service has been appalling.
Comments (Original): [ NO COMPRES EN MEDIAMARKT ] || ---------------- || ¡NO COMPREIS EN MEDIAMARKT! a veces saca ofertas jugosas pero la post venta es pésima. El lavavajillas per se funciona muy bien, limpia muy bien incluso teniendo platos con muchos restos. Los táper en la parte de abajo se limpian también sin problema, sale todo muy seco. El problema es que vienen dos gomas laterales que tienes que poner tú y que se pegan con una tira de pegamento que viene incorporada la cual se despega constantemente. He pedido una nueva goma (ya que solo es una la que se cae) pero no me mandan repuesto, por lo que muy decepcionada por este lado. Al final, si pones el lavavajillas y esa goma no está bien colocada, se sale el agua porque la puerta no encaja bien del todo (gotas, no a chorro, pero se sale). No sé si merece la pena gastar tanto dinero teniendo en cuenta ese detalle. La solución que me dan es que lleve el lavavajillas a una tienda y pida el reembolso que tarda más de 15 días, con lo fácil que sería mandarme una goma nueva... Además las formas en el trato han sido pésimas.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for about a year now.
Comments (English): [ Would not buy it again! ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for about a year now. I bought it because it was a perfect size for my small kitchen and it was fingerprint resistant. I could never find the time to review it though, but after being annoyed by its features for too long, I want to share my experience. This dishwasher has been designed for the disabled consumers, and the racks, especially the bottom one is incredibly low to the ground. If you have any back problems, do not get this appliance. The constant bending while loading the dishes is really uncomfortable and not good for your back. The layout inside is not great and I miss my 20 year old dishwasher. This machine has incredibly long washing cycles, which does not do wonders for my electric bill, 2.5 hours for normal cycle with extended drying. It does not dry the dishes even with an extended extended drying cycle on. While I am emptying it, I literally stand with a dishwashing towel to finish the job that this machine should be doing. I find the third rack of limited use because of its depth. The utensil basket is poorly designed. It's missing the compartments with the lids in it and you cannot separate utensil; it's all continuous compartment with holes in it. It also misses the gently cycle for washing china. I miss my 20 year old Maytag on all these counts.

Comments (English): [ A Good Washer . But Has Room To Improve ] || ---------------- || Purchased and installed 1/1/2026 Installation Comments: Typical installation but the detailed instructions and documentation were poor. The three point leveling was a nice feature but the instructions indicated a flat bladed screwdriver the be used to adjust the front feet, and this is not correct and will damage the feet. The orientation of the upper cabinet clips, which had to be installed before the washer was moved into position, was not clear and they did not locate the washer laterally if not oriented correctly. Worse, an unmarked plastic funnel was left over. We checked the documents for included components or instructions and found no reference. Now, one month later it is time to refill the salt (salt fill instructions were hard to find) … and only now do we know what the funnel is for. It is lost and the replacement is $30. Pro's. Very quiet, as expected for this 38db model. Interior lighting is an unexpectedly nice feature. Excellent cleaning performance, glassware comes out especially nice. Front info display is nice for a top of door control model. Excellent appearance and build quality. Con's. Lack of common features. No finished washing indicator: from the front a load of dirty dishes looks the same as clean ones. Even our 10 year old KitchenAid had an indicator light. No delayed start switch on the door control panel; delayed start can only be done with the Bosch Connect app, (I believe the SHP78DM5N 800 series does have a control panel delay switch, as do the 500 series). This model has the premium glide racks, but they don't hold common sized wine glasses or normal sized baking sheets, and there are no clips. There is an accessory kit for sale but really…on a $2,000 washer? Worst Feature. The Bosch Connect app; difficult to set up initially, busy and non-intuitive menus, way too much clutter with non-dishwasher control stuff, such as “Recommended Products and Services”. Many times we must restart the app to connect with the washer, an apparent wake up issue within the Wi-Fi module. Service warnings on the washer info display appear 24-48 hours before they appear on the app. Having to find your iPhone and use a sales-oriented app to run the dishwasher is a constant irritation when the door controls should be able to do everything except the customized settings.

Sentence (English): My teenagers don't always take out the dishes on time, so they often pile up.
Comments (English): [ I thought about it a lot, but it’s so, so, so good. ] || ---------------- || My teenagers don't always take out the dishes on time, so they often pile up. Plus, cooking basically generates a huge amount of dishes, so I started wondering if getting a dishwasher would be a good idea. I considered a built-in 12- to 14-place setting model, but I hesitated because it would require removing the base cabinets and reducing storage space. Then I found out about 6-place setting dishwashers; I figured if I excluded items that aren't used in dishwashers, like frying pans and rice cookers, it wouldn't be too insufficient. I was worried about the space it would take up and the protruding wiring, but it fit perfectly in my kitchen without looking too cramped (a smaller size wouldn't fit inside as well, right? ^^). It also looks fine once I positioned it so the visible wiring is minimal. The timer shows 1 hour and 35 minutes, which seems a bit long, but I was told that it runs a fan-drying cycle even after the automatic door opens. I used it for the first time today, and as long as you secure it properly, you can fit more than I expected. It's so convenient because it reduces the time spent standing while washing dishes. If you are considering buying a dishwasher, I highly recommend it! After using it for two days, I found it convenient to use the quick cycle with an extra rinse cycle set to 34 minutes. Plus, guests were coming over today, so I had to do the dishes five or six times; using the dishwasher made things so much easier and better. Also, since prices vary widely, I recommend checking Coupang frequently before purchasing. I got a card discount and bought mine for just under 450,000 won.

Comments (English): [ A Good Washer . But Has Room To Improve ] || ---------------- || Purchased and installed 1/1/2026. Installation Comments:. Typical installation but the detailed instructions and documentation were poor. The three point leveling was a nice feature but the instructions indicated a flat bladed screwdriver the be used to adjust the front feet, and this is not correct and will damage the feet. The orientation of the upper cabinet clips, which had to be installed before the washer was moved into position, was not clear and they did not locate the washer laterally if not oriented correctly. Worse, an unmarked plastic funnel was left over. We checked the documents for included components or instructions and found no reference. Now, one month later it is time to refill the salt (salt fill instructions were hard to find) … and only now do we know what the funnel is for. It is lost and the replacement is $30. Pro's. Very quiet, as expected for this 38db model. Interior lighting is an unexpectedly nice feature. Excellent cleaning performance, glassware comes out especially nice. Front info display is nice for a top of door control model. Excellent appearance and build quality. Con's. Lack of common features. No finished washing indicator: from the front a load of dirty dishes looks the same as clean ones. Even our 10 year old KitchenAid had an indicator light. No delayed start switch on the door control panel; delayed start can only be done with the Bosch Connect app, (I believe the SHP78DM5N 800 series does have a control panel delay switch, as do the 500 series). This model has the premium glide racks, but they don't hold common sized wine glasses or normal sized baking sheets, and there are no clips. There is an accessory kit for sale but really…on a $2,000 washer? Worst Feature. The Bosch Connect app; difficult to set up initially, busy and non-intuitive menus, way too much clutter with non-dishwasher control stuff, such as “Recommended Products and Services”. Many times we must restart the app to connect with the washer, an apparent wake up issue within the Wi-Fi module. Service warnings on the washer info display appear 24-48 hours before they appear on the app. Having to find your iPhone and use a sales-oriented app to run the dishwasher is a constant irritation when the door controls should be able to do everything except the customized settings.

Sentence (English): This is a good machine , washers and dries properly, no need to preclean dishes and has a very good Eco cycle.
Comments (English): This is a good machine , washers and dries properly, no need to preclean dishes and has a very good Eco cycle. It has ample room for dishes pots ,pans cups etc and is quiet. Ours was purchased through Harvey Norman and the Salesman's product knowledge was very good. It has a salt dispenser but for Melbourne water it's not required, just fill the tank with water . I don't like the plastic covered micro switches , you feel like you need to press again or harder to start the machine. Once you press the on button there is a few seconds delay which can cause some confusion. Under the Start/pause button is a graphic and it says 3 sec. If you press the start button for 3 seconds it cancels the program . This graphic and the 3 sec are not explained in the manual, but it actually drains the machine if you need to. I actually thought our machine was faulty and rang Harvey Norman who hand passed the issue to Aristic ( whirlpool repair service). Harvey Norman don't offer customer service, instead of calling me to tell me their procedure and then following up with whirlpool and letting me know what's happening they just sent me an email and said to call Whirlpool if I haven't heard anything. They have a repair procedure but not a customer service follow up. Anyway the Aristic Tech said that they get this all the time and the manual should be up dated . I think perhaps Harvey Norman should have known this. So ,the machine works fine and starts with 1 quick push on the start button. After the initial hiccup I can confidently recommend this Whirlpool machine , I just would like a knob to turn or a proper button to press but that's me. Hope this helps.

I cannot speak on the cleaning yet this is just my first impression during the test run. However, the slate coating seems less durable, there is a small gouge in the pigment near the control panel which went unnoticed until I wiped the door front after installation. I would also like to mention that in order to properly install this model, all the plumbing needs to run from the back half of the dishwasher. If your water inlet or discharge line is directly behind the kick plate anywhere towards the front- the front legs and frame will prevent this model from fully sliding under the counter top - preventing the seamless look GE is known for, unless you reroute your plumbing. I really love GE appliances in slate but this purchase has left me a little bummed.I will update my review if my opinion changes after consistent use.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher after a disappointing experience with another premium brand.
Comments (English): [ High quality dishwasher with a few nice features ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher after a disappointing experience with another premium brand. So far, I've been very impressed with the Bosch for a few reasons. First, it appears to be well built. For example, the insulation that surrounds the outside of the dishwasher is well secured, unlike a "blanket" that other brands use (and will stick to the inside of the cabinet or come loose.) I also like the fact that the cord just plugs into the back of the dishwasher and doesn't require hard wiring it (especially in the front of the dishwasher, like my previous one.) The installers had a plug-and-play cord (which we used) or the junction box (if needed). I also like that the heating element is not exposed in the bottom of the dishwasher, a common design that can lead to melted plastics. The Bosch actually allows you to put plastic containers anywhere in the dishwasher, as they won't melt. The wi-fi feature is nice, but not necessary, though I do like getting a notification to my phone that the dishwasher has completed its cycle and can be emptied. I do wish that there was a "clean" light on the front panel, as the lights do go out after the cycle and can leave you wondering if it's clean or dirty. I bought a "clean/dirty" magnet to solve that issue. It is a bit louder than our previous dishwasher, but not so much as to disrupt the kitchen, and I suppose I could have paid a bit more for a quieter unit. Dishes have always come out clean and dry with no issues. The manual makes it seem like using a rinse aid is very important; which we have done. I really like that Bosch uses a premium screen filter at the bottom of the tub to catch any solid items that could otherwise clog the drain hose; not all dishwashers are built this way, and so this one seems built to last. I hope to have many years of good service from this premium appliance.

Sentence (English): Since I started sharing the dishwasher with my children, the amount of dishes I wash has increased significantly.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that can be used for six people, with just one button. ] || ---------------- || Since I started sharing the dishwasher with my children, the amount of dishes I wash has increased significantly. Washing dishes by hand every time is both time-consuming and physically demanding, so I decided to invest in this 6-person dishwasher, which is perfect for home use. I use it almost every day, loading both adult and children's dishes and running it once every day or two. Because it's a countertop dishwasher, I installed it without taking up much kitchen space. This was my first dishwasher, so I don't have anything to compare it to, but compared to handwashing, it's definitely a breeze. It even automatically washes, dries, and sterilizes dishes, which is a definite plus for a house with children. Pros: 1. Washes, sterilizes, and sterilizes dishes with the push of a button. Just loading the dishes and pressing a button is all it takes, so I barely have to worry about washing dishes. 2. The automatic door-opening feature is convenient. After each cycle, the door automatically opens, reducing the humidity and improving drying. 3. The bottle-sterilizing function is a plus for a house with children. Not having to hand-wash the children's dishes is incredibly convenient. It also gives me peace of mind about hygiene. 4. Internal maintenance is possible with the full sterilization mode. Since the dishwasher itself can be maintained with the touch of a button, the burden of machine maintenance is reduced. Cons: It definitely takes a long time. The standard cycle takes about 1 hour and 55 minutes, so if you need it urgently, you'll need to pre-heat it. It's designed for six people, so the capacity is limited. It's suitable for two to three-person households, but larger families might find it a bit tight to load everything at once. Recommended/not recommended for: Households with a lot of dishes due to children, two to three-person households, or first-time dishwashers. Not recommended for: Large families or households that handle a lot of dishes at once. Overall: I understand why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. After using it, it's so convenient that I can't go back to the old days without it, and I think families with children will be even more satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ 설거지 해방템, 버튼 하나로 끝나는 6인용 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 아이 식기까지 같이 쓰다 보니 설거지 양이 확 늘었어요. 매번 손설거지하다 보니 시간도 체력도 부담돼서, 집에서 쓰기 좋은 6인용 식기세척기로 이 제품을 들이게 됐어요. 집에서 거의 매일 사용 중이고, 어른 식기 + 아이 식기 같이 넣어서 하루이틀에 1회 정도 돌려요. 카운터탑 타입이라 주방 공간 크게 손대지 않고 설치했어요. 식세기 자체가 처음이라 비교 대상은 없지만, 손설거지랑 비교하면 생활이 편해졌어요. 설거지·건조·살균까지 알아서 해줘서, 아이 있는 집에선 체감 편의성이 확실했어요.장점1.버튼 하나로 설거지부터 건조·살균까지식기 넣고 버튼만 누르면 끝이라, 설거지 신경 쓰는 시간이 거의 없어졌어요.2.완료 후 자동 문열림 기능이 편함코스 끝나면 문이 자동으로 열려서 습기 차는 느낌이 덜하고 건조도 더 잘 되는 느낌이었어요.3.젖병살균 기능이 있어 아이 있는 집에 좋음아이 식기를 따로 손설거지 안 해도 된다는 게 진짜 편했어요. 위생적으로도 마음이 놓였고요.4.통살균 모드로 내부 관리 가능식세기 자체 관리도 버튼으로 해결되니까 기계 관리에 대한 부담이 덜했어요.아쉬운 점•시간은 확실히 오래 걸림표준 코스 기준 약 1시간 55분이라, 급하게 필요할 땐 미리 돌려야 해요.•6인용이라 용량은 한계가 있음2~3인 가구엔 적당한데, 그 이상 가족이면 한 번에 다 넣긴 조금 빠듯할 수 있어요.이런 사람에게 추천/비추천•추천: 아이 식기 때문에 설거지 많은 집, 2~3인 가구, 처음 식세기 들이는 경우•비추천: 대가족이거나 한 번에 많은 식기 처리해야 하는 집총평요즘 식세기가 필수가전이라고 하는 이유를 알겠더라고요. 써보니 없던 시절로는 못 돌아갈 정도로 편했고, 아이 있는 집이라면 만족도 더 높을 것 같아요.

Comments (English): [ Mostly good ] || ---------------- || In general, the dishwasher is a good step up from what we had previously. There are 2 issues that we have had to deal with. 1. During transport as the product bounced around, the torque on the latch from side to side would simply break it up. We kept the third machine even though the latch was still broken but usable. 2. The drying feature works most of the time. A couple of times it has failed to dry anything. 3. I don't like the placement of the water input connection. The design makes it very difficult to tighten sufficiently without removing the bracket from the frame, tightening it down and then reattaching the bracket to the frame. On the whole it is a good machine and reasonably quiet.

Comments (English): [ Love everything but the heating element smell ] || ---------------- || Overall three weeks in to using our new dishwasher and it is far and above a better machine than our previous GE contractor special. I've developed a slight love/hate relationship with the upper rack. It isn't an even depth across and so if I put taller items on the left side of the middle rack they catch on the lower protruding portion of the upper rack but I can't really lower the middle rack or my sheet pans won't fit in the bottom rack. I do like the adjust-ability of the middle rack. I usually leave it at the highest setting but have lowered in on two occasions with ease. Having that little bit of versatility is nice. My one major complaint is the smell of the heating element. We're over three weeks in and it still makes me think something is about to melt or catch fire every time it kicks on. Tonight I forgot to cancel the power dry portion of the cycle since I only use the air dry feature that auto opens the door a crack at the end of the rinse cycle if it isn't power drying. I thought from the smell that my dryer had caught fire. It's pretty strong when its just heating the water but when it's heating the air it's way stronger even after three weeks. I don't know how you would fix it but it will still take some getting used to.

Sentence (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] LG 12-Place Dishwasher Real-World Review.
Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] LG 12-Place Dishwasher Real-World Review. When eating three meals a day at home, washing dishes is a household chore that takes more time than you might think. After much consideration, I purchased the LG Dios 12-place dishwasher. The 12-place setting is the most commonly used capacity in typical households, and it is ideal for washing pots and large plates together. After actually using it, I understood why many people call it a "quality of life appliance." 2. The Most Satisfying Advantage: Dishwashing time is practically eliminated. The biggest advantage is simple: dishwashing time is reduced. In particular, the stress of washing dishes in the evening has almost disappeared. More Hygienic Washing Than Hand Washing. One of the advantages of a dishwasher is high-temperature washing. Most dishwashers use high-temperature water at 60 to 70 degrees or higher. In this regard, it is often more advantageous than hand washing. Additionally, since it performs drying after washing, hygienic maintenance is possible. It actually uses less water. There is a common misconception among many people: they think dishwashers use a lot of water. However, the reality is the opposite. Hand washing uses running water continuously, so water usage is significantly high. On the other hand, dishwashers wash with a fixed amount of water. Based on some models, it is known to use approximately 8 to 12 liters of water per wash, which can be significantly less than hand washing. It is quieter than expected. I was worried about the noise at first, but after actually using it, it is quite quiet. Generally, dishwasher noise is around 45 dB, which is known to be about the same level as a typical office. It can wash large plates and pots. The advantage of a 12-place setting dishwasher is its spacious interior. Therefore, it is especially convenient when there is a large amount of dishes to wash. 3. Additional advantages felt during actual use: Hands become less dry. If you continue to wash dishes by hand, your hands often become dry due to the detergent. Kitchen organization becomes easier. Using a dishwasher establishes a routine, making the kitchen much cleaner. 4. Especially recommended for these people. Recommended based on actual use. Households that cook frequently. If there are many pots or frying pans to wash, the effect of a dishwasher is very noticeable. 2-4 person households. The 12-place setting is the most commonly used size in general households. People who find dishwashing stressful. Since dishwashing is a daily chore, it is one of the home appliances where automation is most effective. 5. Things to consider before purchasing. Dish placement is important. For a dishwasher, proper placement improves cleaning performance. It takes some time to get used to it at first. Use a dedicated detergent. You must use dishwasher-specific detergent, not regular dish soap. 6. Overall review. Key advantages I experienced while using the LG 12-place setting dishwasher. Significantly reduced dishwashing time. Hygienic due to high-temperature washing. Water usage saved. Quieter operation than expected. Capable of washing even large dishes. If this post has been of even a little help to those considering purchasing a dishwasher, please click "Helpful" once; it would be a great help.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for just over a year.
Comments (English): [ It's about 16 months old and it's rusting on the inside. ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for just over a year. I bought it because it was quiet and I just had to have that door that pops open when the cycle is finished. It has Wi-Fi, I can start it remotely. Who wouldn't want that? But after having it a year I'm here to say that all of that doesn't make up for the fact that the filter assembly in the bottom of the dishwasher is rusting. Let me say that again, it is just over a year old and the filter assembly is rusting. I just spent about 45 minutes with Barkeepers's Friend scrubbing the screen that surrounds the filter and the pocket that screen fits in all around the edges to remove rust. Now I'm wondering exactly how often I'm going to have to do that to keep the entire barrel of the dishwasher from rusting. Since rust, like a bad mood, spreads. Why would a company with such a stellar reputation put something on the inside of a DISHWASHER that was capable of rust? Yes, we have a lot of minerals in the water here, I'm not seeing mineral buildup, not even in the jets. But it's darn sure rusting. So, for that reason and that reason alone Biosch is getting a two star from me because I realize that I am going to have to replace this dishwasher probably in about two or three years because of rust in a place where it can't help but come into contact with water. Color me very unhappy

Sentence (English): This was replacing a 18yr old dishwasher from another brand.
Comments (English): [ New Dishwasher after 18years First KitchenAid ] || ---------------- || This was replacing a 18yr old dishwasher from another brand. I looked at hundreds of dishwashers across all the brands. I bought this one due to features, made in US and appearance as I was tired of looking at shiny stainless steel in my kitchen and this new Black Ore color was nice. This washer shares many of the same features, parts and design as the Whirlpool but with a few nicer touches. It cleans well. I don't think its as quiet as they claim but its much quieter then my old washer. The door and handle are solid. The controls are very sensitive probably to much so when wiping down. I do like the 4 second count down after you press start. The door opener is neat for people like me that dont use the heat dry cycles on my washers here in Colorado where it super dry. I never used it my old 18yr washer either. All the heat can reduce component service life. The door does not drop but its a bit stiff when laying all the way down. The racks are nice but the middle and top rack could be made to slide easier in and out and do feel a bit mid grade. Most companies never get this right when its so simple. The racks load well and have good tine pattern for the most part but the lanes could be wider. The dryer vent near the floor is a in different position then the Whirlpool. Depending on who much you use heated dry if you have wood floors the vent near the floor could be an issue. I found the sound insulation blanket cheap and crappy. For a few more dollars it could have been better. It has a louder drain cycle then I expected and more so then compared to an older much cheaper 18yr old washer. Ejection pump to the drain was not analyzed well. Time will tell how long it lasts. I only run 1-2 loads a week by myself. I certainly did not like trying to remove the plastic wrap from the door. The assembled it with the wrap stuck between the door panels and it was nearly impossible to remove without taking the door part and Im not using a razor blade to score and nick the steel. I still have bits and pieces around the door and control panel. Not happy about that. There were a few small corners where the steel angle bends were missing paint coating like 1-3mm points. The assembly instructions need work and you have to log into the website to get the complete instructions. They are missing some important notes about assembly the bottom access panel so it doesn't jam up on the vent on the bottom of the door. For a unit at this price point providing complete installation instructions should be a given. The leak detection is a nice feature. The leak pain should cover more then the water inlet though.

Sentence (English): I installed a built-in 14-seater dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The installation is clean. ] || ---------------- || I installed a built-in 14-seater dishwasher. While the main unit is about the same size as the 12-seater, the improved internal basket configuration allows for significantly more dishes, allowing me to handle a full day's worth of dishes and pots in one go. It's also surprisingly quiet, so even if I set a timer late at night, it won't disturb TV or games in the living room. After the dishwasher is done, the door automatically opens slightly to allow hot air to naturally dry the dishes, leaving virtually no moisture on the dishes for immediate cleanup. I was concerned about the electricity and water bill, but now that I can run it all at once, I feel like I use less water than when I used to wash dishes by hand multiple times. I anticipate a lower operating cost in the long run. For a household of three or four or more, the 14-seater is a more satisfying choice in terms of space utilization and accessibility.
Comments (Original): [ 설치가 깔끔합니다. ] || ---------------- || 14인용 식기세척기를 빌트인으로 설치했습니다. 본체 크기는 12인용과 거의 비슷한데, 내부 바스켓 구성이 좋아서 그릇이 훨씬 많이 들어가 하루 치 그릇과 냄비까지 한 번에 해결됩니다. 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 저녁 늦게 타이머 걸어 돌려도 거실에서 TV 보거나 게임할 때 방해가 안 되고, 세척이 끝난 뒤 문이 자동으로 살짝 열리면서 열풍·자연건조가 같이 되다 보니 그릇에 물기가 거의 남지 않아 바로 정리하기 좋습니다. 전기·수도 요금이 걱정됐지만 한 번에 몰아서 돌리다 보니, 예전에 여러 번 나눠 손설거지할 때보다 물 사용량이 줄어드는 느낌이라 장기적으로 운영비 부담도 크지 않을 것 같고, 3~4인 이상 가구라면 12인용보다는 14인용을 선택한 게 공간 활용이나 동선 면에서 확실히 만족스러운 선택이었습니다.

Sentence (English): Samsung Dishwasher Review (Replacement after Using SK Magic).
Comments (English): [ Samsung Dishwasher Review (Replacement after Using SK Magic) I switched from an SK Magic dishwasher to a Samsung product. It's not a completely different world, but it feels a step more stable overall. ] || ---------------- || Samsung Dishwasher Review (Replacement after Using SK Magic). I used an SK Magic dishwasher, but I switched to a Samsung model. It's not a complete change of pace, but it feels a step more stable overall. Pros: 1. The three-tiered cutlery tray is definitely convenient. Loading cutlery was always tricky with my old SK Magic, but the Samsung has a dedicated three-tiered cutlery tray, making it easy to organize. Since cutlery doesn't overlap, the results are more consistent. 2. The operating noise is definitely quieter. I didn't notice it much even at night. It's not completely silent, but it's barely noticeable in the house. Cons: 1. There's no forced drying function. This is a definite drawback. When you open the dishwasher right after washing, there's often moisture left behind, especially on plastic containers and the bottom of cups. Ultimately, you have to find a way to fix this, like leaving the door slightly ajar or allowing a little more time for natural drying. Expecting it to dry fluffy automatically will disappoint. Overall: I'm satisfied with the cleaning power, noise, and internal layout. However, I'd advise lowering your expectations when it comes to drying.

Sentence (English): I liked the heating element in the bottom.
Comments (English): [ Love my Kitchen Aid! ] || ---------------- || I liked the heating element in the bottom. I can't believe that other brands are dropping this feature! The dishes don't get dry unless there is a way to dry them, and venting through a hose at the side does not cut it. I like the way the controls are at the front panel, I like the way the dishes fit straight up in the racks. I like the clean dishes and the fact that the door pops open and the clean/sanitized light stays on. I like that you don't have to connect the dishwasher to your phone to get it to work. What moron thought you would want to start your dishwasher from anywhere but your home? Would you actually remember to put a soap tablet in it before you left the house so they would be clean when you came home? The only negative I have for my Kitchen Aid is that it didn't come with a cord to plug into the wall. I had to get an electrician to come put one on for me. But it works great now. Very happy with this brand over Bosch 1000%

Sentence (English): I expected a high-quality experience from Bosch, but it has been a massive disappointment.
Comments (English): [ Bosch - Horrible Experience ] || ---------------- || I expected a high-quality experience from Bosch, but it has been a massive disappointment. My brand-new unit arrived with black residue inside (photos). If you buy one, be prepared to spend hours arguing with customer service just to get what you paid for.My advice is to avoid Bosch. Don't fall for the Bosch hype. They essentially tried to gaslight me despite having photographic proof that it arrived defective. I only got a resolution because my local repairman was kind enough to help me deal with them.

Sentence (English): When I first got my dishwasher, I thought it would just do the dishes for me, but after actually using it, my quality of life has drastically improved.
Comments (English): When I first got my dishwasher, I thought it would just do the dishes for me, but after actually using it, my quality of life has drastically improved. If I schedule it before work, it'll clean all the plates and cups that have accumulated over the day in one go, virtually eliminating the time I'd spend washing dishes by hand. I was especially pleased with how even things like glasses and greasy frying pans felt cleaner. The most surprising thing after installing it was the noise. It's surprisingly quiet, sometimes even quieter than the sound of a vacuum cleaner, and it reduces stress in the living room and kitchen. The internal racks are also well-designed, neatly organizing everything from large plates to small cups, spoons, and forks, making loading a breeze. Of course, you can't just throw everything in there; you'll need to shake off any large, stuck-on food particles to achieve optimal cleaning power. But if you do that, you can practically eliminate the stress of dishwashing these days. Even with a large family, you can handle everything at once, and your home feels much more organized. Overall, this is a truly recommended appliance for anyone looking for time savings and peace of mind.

Sentence (English): So many options for cleaning cycles and easy to set.
Comments (English): [ Cleaning is top notch ] || ---------------- || So many options for cleaning cycles and easy to set. I generally use the 1 hour cycle and it gets everything super clean. You can set for just the top or bottom rack or both, water bottle jets or not, super dry or moderately dry or complete air dry, time delay, and a variety of cleaning levels. I've had many dishwashers in my lifetime and this is by far the best. I love the jets under the silverware tray. I've never had silverware not get completely clean. It is quiet as it claims. The manual and directions lack quality instruction but the controls are easy to figure out. The buttons are on the top and no more sensitive than any other dishwasher. It will continuously beep if you press start and the door isn't all the way latched closed. If you don't intend to start it, you can easily cancel by pressing the start button and holding which is clearly labeled on the display. I would highly recommend this dishwasher and rank it as one of the best.

Sentence (English): I thought I would try a Bosch dishwasher as I have heard a lot of positive reviews.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher but getting the HomeConnect to pair was an issue ] || ---------------- || I thought I would try a Bosch dishwasher as I have heard a lot of positive reviews. I needed a dishwasher that was also panel ready as my prior dishwasher had a panel and I wanted to reuse it. The Home Depot delivery and installation went well (they don't install the panel). I had installed the panel that was on our KitchenAid dishwasher so I felt I could do this one. The Bosch installation was easier and only took about 15 minutes. After Home Depot did the installation I downloaded the HomeConnect App and tried to pair it with my dishwasher. I am pretty techie but I couldn't get the WiFi on the dishwasher to come on and pair. I had to call support and they walked me through a reset and waiting a certain amount of time for draining (there was no water to drain but you still had to wait for this to complete). I was finally able to get it paired and the rest was quite straight forward. I'm not sure if having the app is an improvement as it is one more app and one more app to learn which was, in the past on older dishwashers it's a pretty simple task. You can still use the dishwasher buttons to do everything so I guess you don't have to use the app. My first load of dishes came out very clean. The big change is the silverware holder is smaller than my old KitcheAid but the top (3rd draw) has room for silverware and other small items. There are a lot of adjustments you can make with the racks s that is a plus. The noise is about what our old dishwasher put out. The dishes came out much dryer and it's nice that the heating element is enclosed (open elements can fry plastics). The size is the same as the old dishwasher but the flexibility of the racks will mean we can load more.

Sentence (English): We bought the dishwasher because of its A energy rating, as we live in a house powered solely by solar energy.
Comments (English): [ Super efficient. ] || ---------------- || We bought the dishwasher because of its A energy rating, as we live in a house powered solely by solar energy. The appliance meets our expectations with low energy consumption on long cycles, and the washing performance on short cycles has also improved significantly, which is what we were most interested in. Connecting it to Wi-Fi was a bit tricky, and it arrived from the factory with minor dents on one side that weren't visible through the packaging, which showed no signs of mishandling as it was well protected. We didn't file a claim because of the hassle of shipping, and it wasn't noticeable during installation anyway. This has happened to us with other products from the same brand purchased from different suppliers. Aside from that, it's a very high-quality product. Comments (Original): [ Super eficiente. ] || ---------------- || Compramos el lavavajillas por su clasificación A ya que vivimos en una casa alimentada tan solo por energía fotovoltáica. El aparato cumple las espectativas con un consumo reducido en programas largos, además ha mejorado mucho el lavado en programas cortos que es lo que nos interesaba. Lo que me costó un poco es conectarlo al wifi y que vino de fabrica con abolladuras leves en un lateral que no se veían con el embalaje y este no tenía signos de maltrato ya que estaba bien protegido, no lo hemos reclamado por lo engorroso del transporte y total no se veía al instalarlo, ya nos ha pasado con otros productos de la marca comprados en diferentes proveedores. Salvo eso, es un producto de mucha calidad, el anterior nos ha durado mas de 20 años y varias mudanzas y aun funcionaba salvo algún botón y que no era tan eficiente como este.

Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwasher Review: Quiet, Smart, and Excepti ] || ---------------- || I've owned my Bosch dishwasher for over two years now, and it has been one of the most dependable appliances in my home. From day one, it has delivered outstanding cleaning performance—dishes consistently come out spotless, even after heavy meals. Pots, pans, glasses, and silverware all emerge clean with no residue, which speaks volumes about the wash power and efficiency. One of my favorite aspects of this dishwasher is how easy it is to program a wash cycle. The controls are intuitive and straightforward, making it simple to select the right cycle for any load without feeling overwhelmed by unnecessary complexity. What truly sets this dishwasher apart, though, is how incredibly quiet it is. During operation, it's practically silent. The only way I know it's running is by the small light projected onto the floor from the bottom of the unit—a thoughtful and clever feature that's especially useful in an open-concept home. I also regularly use the Bosch Home Connect App, which adds a whole new level of convenience. Through the app, I can monitor the wash cycle, receive notifications when the load is finished, and even remotely start the dishwasher. Recently, the app notified me that it was time to run a cleansing cycle without dishes. The instructions were simple, clear, and easy to follow, making maintenance stress-free. From a long-term ownership perspective, reliability has been excellent. After more than two years of regular use, I've had zero issues—no breakdowns, no performance drop, and no maintenance headaches. Energy efficiency, smart features, quiet operation, and consistent cleaning all come together to make this dishwasher a great value. Overall, this Bosch dishwasher checks all my boxes for: excellent cleaning results, whisper-quiet performance, user-friendly controls, smart app integration, and proven reliability. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a high-quality, long-lasting dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is my second KitchenAid dishwasher product.
Comments (English): [ 3rd level utensil rack dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is my second KitchenAid dishwasher product. The dishwasher does what it's supposed to do, however, the installation process was a nightmare. After installation and the men left I found a big dent in the bottom of the dishwasher on the inside of the tub. I can't understand how KitchenAid would allow AHS to give your quality product to a common carrier. They make deliveries not installations. I dont feel they have any idea about how to install dishwashers. As I am an AHS customer it was delivered three times before it was finally installed which cost me approximately $1,000. The "installlers" kept saying they couldn't handle copper, the drain was broken and additionally after my plumber fixed the things that they said were unacceptable they broke one of the pieces of the drain that the plumber had just put in to make it meet the carriers spec, not to mention that they did not notice when they took out the old KitchenAid that there was a clamp attached to a counter top and the old dishwasher now there's a missing piece of my countertop. The picture attached shows the picture of the broken drain which the carrier or the installer left as an open drain under my sink and never advised me not to use my sink. I tried several times to try to make this right with AHS no luck my next call is to your maintenance people. thank you

Sentence (English): I've been using this Bosch 500 Series dishwasher for several weeks now and, overall, I'm very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Very quiet and efficient, but...  ] || ---------------- || I've been using this Bosch 500 Series dishwasher for several weeks now and, overall, I'm very happy with it. It's extremely quiet, to the point that you sometimes forget it's even running. The wash quality is excellent, even with heavily soiled dishes, and the drying system is effective, especially with the extra drying option activated. The interior is well-designed, with sturdy and adjustable baskets, which makes loading different types of dishes easy. Water and energy consumption seem reasonable, which is a big plus. However, there are a few less practical aspects in terms of ergonomics. The door doesn't open automatically at the end of the cycle, which is usually helpful for drying on other models. Also, the buttons aren't always intuitive to use: you sometimes have to press them several times to select the right combination of programs and modes, which can be a bit frustrating on a daily basis. Finally, the cycles are quite long, and some plastic items may remain slightly damp after washing. Despite these points, this is a very reliable, quiet, and efficient dishwasher that I recommend. These minor details explain my 4 out of 5 star rating.
Comments (Original): [ Très silencieux et efficace, mais ... ] || ---------------- || J’utilise ce lave-vaisselle Bosch 500 Series depuis plusieurs semaines et, dans l’ensemble, j’en suis très satisfait. Il est extrêmement silencieux, au point qu’on oublie parfois qu’il fonctionne. La qualité de lavage est excellente, même avec de la vaisselle très sale, et le système de séchage est efficace, surtout avec l’option supplémentaire activée.L’intérieur est bien conçu, avec des paniers solides et modulables, ce qui facilite le chargement de différents types de vaisselle. La consommation d’eau et d’énergie semble raisonnable, ce qui est un point très positif.Par contre, sur le plan de l’ergonomie, il y a quelques aspects moins pratiques. La porte ne s’ouvre pas automatiquement à la fin du cycle, ce qui aide habituellement au séchage sur d’autres modèles. De plus, l’utilisation des boutons n’est pas toujours intuitive : il faut parfois appuyer plusieurs fois pour sélectionner la bonne combinaison de programme et de modes, ce qui peut être un peu frustrant au quotidien.Enfin, les cycles sont assez longs, et certains articles en plastique peuvent rester légèrement humides après le lavage.Malgré ces points, il s’agit d’un lave-vaisselle très fiable, silencieux et performant, que je recommande. Ces petits détails expliquent ma note de 4 étoiles sur 5.

Sentence (English): I wanted to buy the white one, but guess what?

The sink seat is a white tone, so it adds a touch of sophistication without being overpowering. After getting my dishwasher (a "auntie") late, I experienced firsthand why everyone calls it a "new world." ^^. The morning and evening dishes started to pile up. Even though we're a three-person household and rarely order delivery or eat out, washing dishes was a bit stressful. Plus, it felt like my water bill was going up lately. So I asked around for opinions from people who already use dishwashers and checked out reviews, and decided to get my dishwasher. But suddenly, money was tight, so I looked into rental options. I tend to spend most of my living expenses on credit anyway, and as long as I met my budget, I figured a rental would be a good option because it wouldn't be a huge monthly burden and would allow for regular maintenance. Maintenance is crucial for appliances, especially dishwashers. Since I need to pay more attention to maintenance, I chose the six-month service plan. Still, the monthly payment is affordable, so I'm really happy about it. On the day of installation, I piled up a bunch of dishes in the morning, and after installation was complete, I was thrilled to start the cycle! The final sound sounded, the door automatically opened, and after the drying process was complete, I checked the dishes and, squeak! This is it! Also, choosing the right detergent is important when choosing a dishwasher, and in my case, I meticulously researched reviews comparing several options. Between Frosh (tablets) and Sway (liquid capsules), I bought Sway first. I'm aware of the advantages of liquid capsules, so I plan to try Frosh afterward. I think the best way to find your own favorite is to try a few different options and find the pros and cons. I'm still a bit clumsy at dishwashing, so I'm not good at dishwashing, but for now, the dishwasher installation was a godsend for me, saving my wrists, freeing up time, and relieving the stress of washing dishes. Welcome to the new world of dishwashers (with this tip: when buying appliances, always choose a larger capacity, you won't regret it. ^^). I hope this review will be helpful to prospective users. I wrote it in detail. ^^

So I asked around for opinions from people who already use dishwashers and checked out reviews, and decided to get my dishwasher. But suddenly, money was tight, so I looked into rental options. I tend to spend most of my living expenses on credit anyway, and as long as I met my budget, I figured a rental would be a good option because it wouldn't be a huge monthly burden and would allow for regular maintenance. Maintenance is crucial for appliances, especially dishwashers. Since I need to pay more attention to maintenance, I chose the six-month service plan. Still, the monthly payment is affordable, so I'm really happy about it. On the day of installation, I piled up a bunch of dishes in the morning, and after installation was complete, I was thrilled to start the cycle! The final sound sounded, the door automatically opened, and after the drying process was complete, I checked the dishes and, squeak! This is it! Also, choosing the right detergent is important when choosing a dishwasher, and in my case, I meticulously researched reviews comparing several options. Between Frosh (tablets) and Sway (liquid capsules), I bought Sway first. I'm aware of the advantages of liquid capsules, so I plan to try Frosh afterward. I think the best way to find your own favorite is to try a few different options and find the pros and cons. I'm still a bit clumsy at dishwashing, so I'm not good at dishwashing, but for now, the dishwasher installation was a godsend for me, saving my wrists, freeing up time, and relieving the stress of washing dishes. Welcome to the new world of dishwashers (with this tip: when buying appliances, always choose a larger capacity, you won't regret it. ^^). I hope this review will be helpful to prospective users. I wrote it in detail. ^^

So I asked around for opinions from people who already use dishwashers and checked out reviews, and decided to get my dishwasher. But suddenly, money was tight, so I looked into rental options. I tend to spend most of my living expenses on credit anyway, and as long as I met my budget, I figured a rental would be a good option because it wouldn't be a huge monthly burden and would allow for regular maintenance. Maintenance is crucial for appliances, especially dishwashers. Since I need to pay more attention to maintenance, I chose the six-month service plan. Still, the monthly payment is affordable, so I'm really happy about it. If you want to give the ultimate gift of freedom from washing dishes, this is the one for you.
Comments (Original): 장점선물용으로 고민하다가 선택했는데, 받아보신 분 반응이 정말 좋았어요 일단 오브제컬렉션답게 디자인이 너무 깔끔하고 고급스러워서 주방 분위기가 확 살아난다고 하시더라고요 ✨12인용이라 식기 넉넉하게 들어가고, 냄비나 프라이팬도 한 번에 정리돼서 설거지 스트레스가 확 줄었다고 합니다 세척력도 만족스럽다고 하셨고, 특히 기름기 많은 그릇도 뽀득하게 잘 닦여서 놀랐다고 하셨어요.LG 제품이라 소음도 크지 않고, 버튼이나 코스도 직관적이라 쓰기 어렵지 않다는 점도 장점이에요  단점아무래도 빌트인 제품이다 보니 설치가 필요한 점은 살짝 번거로울 수 있어요 처음엔 코스별 사용법을 익히는 데 약간의 적응 시간이 필요하다고 하시더라고요.그리고 가격대가 있다 보니 ‘선물로는 큰 결심’이 필요한 편이에요  총평신혼부부나 집들이, 부모님 선물로 정말 잘 고른 선택이었던 것 같아요 실사용 만족도가 높아서 주는 사람도, 받는 사람도 기분 좋은 선물입니다.주방 가전 하나로 삶의 질이 달라진다는 말, 이 제품 보면 공감하게 돼요 “설거지에서 해방”이라는 최고의 선물을 주고 싶다면 추천합니다 ✨

Sentence (English): Overall the cleaning is exceptional!
Comments (English): [ I'd Change A Few Things…. ] || ---------------- || Overall the cleaning is exceptional! I've never had a dishwasher remove all the food and leave the dishes completely dry! The quietness of the Bosch is wonderful! When I was looking at dishwashers, I narrowed my search to Bosch and Kitchen Aid. Where Bosch could improve is the top silverware rack, the third rack. People want to be able to "drop" their silverware in a rack quickly, they don't want to have to take time to "place" it. With silverware, this is very time consuming. I much prefer the third rack design on the Kitchen Aid because it offers a unique design to accommodate items that you don't want to put on the second rack. It also allows you to just "drop" it in not have to "place" it specifically in a slot. The Kitchen Aid has a better and larger silver basket compared to the Bosch. Also, the Bosch basket tends to fall over, it should be able to easily attach to the sides of the dishwasher so it doesn't fall over. Overall, am I happy, yes. As I said, the cleaning and drying is superb and that was the top reason I decided on the Bosch. I also happened to get it on sale and saved quite a lot, had I not, I probably would have settled on the Kitchen Aid. Improve the third rack design and it would be an awesome appliance!

The cleaning power exceeds my expectations, and even greasy dishes and pots come out clean with a single cycle, which is incredibly satisfying. Seeing my glasses come out clean is so satisfying. The auto-open feature ensures fast drying, and I don't have to worry about any musty odors after use. The intuitive buttons made it easy to use without even reading the manual. It's also energy-efficient, so my electricity bill is lower than I expected, which I appreciate. The installation was also done neatly, and the overall nature beige design makes my kitchen feel much more organized. I picked it because it said white, but what kind of dull gray thing came~. When the dishwasher came home, the house suddenly became dull and tacky. Ugh, what should I do~. I asked my husband if I was colorblind, and he asked me if I bought a gray one. Wow. (By the way~ I hope this helps, 300 and 305 are different products. Everyone is buying them without knowing. 300 is not a craze~ Check the price carefully before buying~ There was a place that sold 300 for a high price, so I guess they bought it at the highest price too. It has the most reviews. They probably bought it because they didn't know. So what's the point? I ended up not liking it either, so I bought the slightly more expensive one when there was something cheaper. The difference isn't that big, so I'll just ignore it. Anyway, the color is more of a problem for me. Many reviews say that 300 is a bright white, so is it really white? This isn't it. If you really want white, don't buy this. This isn't white. It's a dull gray. The gray isn't a pretty gray, so the more I look at it, the more upset I get.) . And check where the electrical cord is located before buying it. In my house, the dishwasher is obviously to the left of the sink, and the outlet is at the end of the counter on the right. I wasn't there when it was installed. Anyway, this is how it was set up. My husband called and asked if I really bought the white one and said it didn't look good and told me to come look. I came home in the afternoon and looked. I didn't want to believe it. I was really crying. I wondered if that was white. It's a completely different color from the picture. My kitchen looks dull. Also, there's an outlet under the sink, and I asked if they could drill a hole in the countertop to put the outlet in, but they said they don't have a drilling machine and can't do that. I understand that could happen. But I think there should be a policy where they'll do it if you ask. If you install a water purifier, they'll drill a hole in the countertop and put in the hose and all the messy lines and take care of everything inside, but the dishwasher is just a piece of cake. I thought that the customer service would be great just because it's a product from a large company, but that was a mistake. How can everyone still have a dishwasher? And why do you buy it like that? Even in our apartment complex, the technician asked if there were people who had the same thing, how they used it. Did you put it in the same location as me? If you put it somewhere else, let me know. Does it make sense to connect the power strip all the way from end to end? He said they all put it in the same location as us and then he just blabbered on. It's not like we're from the 80s or 90s, and who would connect a thick power strip cord from the left end to the right end of the sink and countertop, and there's a large window in the middle? Is this my grandmother's house? I'm really upset and angry. First of all, it's not the technician's fault, but why are the policies and plans like this? Is there no way? What would happen if I were to drill a hole in the countertop? No, but more than anything, the product isn't pretty. Oh my. It's my fault for buying this product and my fault for trusting Samsung. I've lost all affection. All my arrogance. I bought it because it said white, but when it arrived, it was a dull color. I want to throw it away because it's so hot. I want to pull out my hair. Oh, I really don't like the product. I'm upset. It's not pretty, what should I do? It's like crap. What am I supposed to do if it's not pretty? After searching until my eyes fell out, I thought there might be people who had a hard time like me, so I'm leaving this, even if it's just a little.

Sentence (English): I've always owned your typical, average run of the mill type dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Best dish washer I've owned ] || ---------------- || I've always owned your typical, average run of the mill type dishwasher. The one I bought for my cabin was the cheapest sold in the store. Well, you pay what you get for. So a few years later I bought a second hand 500 series Bosh and noticed a significant improvement. So when we needed a replacement for my primary home, I did a lot of research and went with this dishwasher. So far, I haven't had a single dish come out as dirty, but I'm still used to pre-rinsing my dishes before they go in. Gradually, I will start to just scrape and load and save hot water not rinsing. Going with this dish washer, I wanted the best, and it has delivered. I don't use the app much, but it's a nice feature. It also takes a little to learn how to best load, but once you got that down, it does a great job. I do like having the utensil rack on top. They are always clean. The only drawback is starting it up. You need to hit the run botton and close it quick. It is also very silent, so sometimes you're not sure if it is running, but that's what the light reflecting on the floor means. One final thing, it uses a chemical that gets hot when drying, so it's supposedly very energy efficient. I have found that with the drying agent, even plastics come out completely dry. I'd wholeheartedly recommend this dishwahser.

We couldn't be more satisifed.

Sentence (English): I purchased this unit in early December 2025.
Comments (English): [ Defective unit. or was it the installer? ] || ---------------- || I purchased this unit in early December 2025. It took almost a month for installation and delivery. I noticed when the installer was leaving that the door was not level, and the right side stuck further out than the left. I figured it was not a big deal, so I let it be. Flash forward two weeks, and I notice small puddles on the floor in front of the dishwasher. I chalked it up to my son opening the door while it was running. The unit is very quiet, so this might happen if you're not paying attention. Flash forward another week, and the water puddle has gotten bigger, now I'm worried because we have wood floors. I called Lowe's, and they sent the same installer out within 48 hours. He basically looks at the unit and, within 30 minutes, has determined it is defective. What exactly is defective? Who knows. It seemed to be working fine, cleaning perfectly, and drying great, super quiet. Now all of asudden it's defective. This is not the bad part. I'm waiting another week for the replacemet and I get a call to tell me that this unit is out of stock, and will not be restocked. So I now have to go into the store to deal with getting a replacement. I purchased this unit on sale, at a great price, and now any dishwasher I would even consider is full price. Not to mention, I had researched this unit and selected it for the great reviews and the features I needed. I truly feel like the installer broke the door with his super-fast installation (20 minutes), and it progressively started leaking more and more. Not sure when this will end, since I have no idea how long it will take to get the replacement after I pick it out. I'll update the review about the new installation later.

Flash forward two weeks, and I notice small puddles on the floor in front of the dishwasher. I chalked it up to my son opening the door while it was running. The unit is very quiet, so this might happen if you're not paying attention. Flash forward another week, and the water puddle has gotten bigger, now I'm worried because we have wood floors. I called Lowe's, and they sent the same installer out within 48 hours. He basically looks at the unit and, within 30 minutes, has determined it is defective. What exactly is defective? Who knows. It seemed to be working fine, cleaning perfectly, and drying great, super quiet. Now all of asudden it's defective. This is not the bad part. I'm waiting another week for the replacemet and I get a call to tell me that this unit is out of stock, and will not be restocked. So I now have to go into the store to deal with getting a replacement. I purchased this unit on sale, at a great price, and now any dishwasher I would even consider is full price. Not to mention, I had researched this unit and selected it for the great reviews and the features I needed. I truly feel like the installer broke the door with his super-fast installation (20 minutes), and it progressively started leaking more and more. Not sure when this will end, since I have no idea how long it will take to get the replacement after I pick it out. I'll update the review about the new installation later.

Sentence (English): Motivation for Purchase: A thoughtful gift to free my mother from the chore of washing dishes.
Comments (English): Motivation for Purchase: A thoughtful gift to free my mother from the chore of washing dishes. I decided to purchase a dishwasher for my mother, who often says that washing dishes is the most exhausting part of the housework. Since our household tends to produce a lot of dishes, I initially considered a 12-place setting built-in model, thinking that bigger was always better. However, considering several practical issues and my parents' health, I ultimately chose a 6-place setting countertop model. Reasons for choosing the 6-place setting instead of the 12 (Key Points of a Gift for Parents): 1. Ease of Installation: My mother was strongly opposed to the fact that the 12-place setting model requires completely removing the lower sink cabinets and undertaking renovations. The countertop style, which can be placed directly on the countertop without altering the kitchen layout, was much cleaner. 2. Ergonomic Design for the Elderly: With the 12-place setting, one must bend deeply at the waist every time dishes are loaded or removed. Hearing that even this is a significant burden for seniors whose knees and backs are not what they used to be, I determined that the 6-place setting, which allows for comfortable loading while standing, was much more suitable. Actual Size and Usability: Capacity is more sufficient than I feared. I was quite worried because many online reviews stated that the 6-person capacity was too small and would be full after just one pot. However, upon receiving the actual product, I found the internal design to be more efficient than expected, and it is sufficient to handle a single meal for a family of 3 to 4 people. Even if we wash large pots separately, just managing the spoons, bowls, and plates that pile up every meal makes me feel like my mother's workload has been cut in more than half. User Satisfaction and Features. The feature my mother is most satisfied with is the hot air drying function. Since it completely dries the water with hot air after washing, the dishes feel fluffy and sanitized, so she uses it with peace of mind. Thanks to the clean white design characteristic of Bespoke, the kitchen atmosphere has brightened up, and since the operation is not complicated, my mother adapted quickly. Pros. 1. It is ideal for the elderly as dishes can be stored while standing without bending over. 2. It can be installed easily without any sink renovation work. 3. The hot air drying function enables hygienic dish care. 4. It boasts a sophisticated design that blends well with kitchen interiors. Cons and Considerations. 1. You should keep in mind that it takes up some countertop space. 2. It may be difficult to fit large cooking utensils, such as very large frying pans or stockpots, all at once. Overall Review: At first, I was worried it might be too small, but after actually using it, it was the best choice that brought peace to my home. Especially if you are placing it in your parents' home, I would definitely recommend the 6-person countertop model for the sake of their back health. Seeing my mother relax comfortably without worrying about washing dishes makes me think I should have bought this for her sooner; it is a highly satisfying item. #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry

Since our household tends to produce a lot of dishes, I initially considered a 12-place setting built-in model, thinking that bigger was always better. However, considering several practical issues and my parents' health, I ultimately chose a 6-place setting countertop model. Reasons for choosing the 6-place setting instead of the 12 (Key Points of a Gift for Parents): 1. Ease of Installation: My mother was strongly opposed to the fact that the 12-place setting model requires completely removing the lower sink cabinets and undertaking renovations. The countertop style, which can be placed directly on the countertop without altering the kitchen layout, was much cleaner. 2. Ergonomic Design for the Elderly: With the 12-place setting, one must bend deeply at the waist every time dishes are loaded or removed. Hearing that even this is a significant burden for seniors whose knees and backs are not what they used to be, I determined that the 6-place setting, which allows for comfortable loading while standing, was much more suitable. Actual Size and Usability: Capacity is more sufficient than I feared. I was quite worried because many online reviews stated that the 6-person capacity was too small and would be full after just one pot. However, upon receiving the actual product, I found the internal design to be more efficient than expected, and it is sufficient to handle a single meal for a family of 3 to 4 people. Even if we wash large pots separately, just managing the spoons, bowls, and plates that pile up every meal makes me feel like my mother's workload has been cut in more than half. User Satisfaction and Features. The feature my mother is most satisfied with is the hot air drying function. Since it completely dries the water with hot air after washing, the dishes feel fluffy and sanitized, so she uses it with peace of mind. Thanks to the clean white design characteristic of Bespoke, the kitchen atmosphere has brightened up, and since the operation is not complicated, my mother adapted quickly. Pros. 1. It is ideal for the elderly as dishes can be stored while standing without bending over. 2. It can be installed easily without any sink renovation work. 3. The hot air drying function enables hygienic dish care. 4. It boasts a sophisticated design that blends well with kitchen interiors. Cons and Considerations. 1. You should keep in mind that it takes up some countertop space. 2. It may be difficult to fit large cooking utensils, such as very large frying pans or stockpots, all at once. Overall Review: At first, I was worried it might be too small, but after actually using it, it was the best choice that brought peace to my home. Especially if you are placing it in your parents' home, I would definitely recommend the 6-person countertop model for the sake of their back health. Seeing my mother relax comfortably without worrying about washing dishes makes me think I should have bought this for her sooner; it is a highly satisfying item. #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry
Comments (Original): ■ 구매 동기: 어머니의 설거지 해방을 위한 효도 선물평소 집안일 중 설거지가 가장 고되다고 하시는 어머니를 위해 식기세척기를 장만해 드리기로 했습니다. 저희 집이 그릇이 많이 나오는 편이라 처음에는 무조건 큰 게 좋다는 생각에 12인용 빌트인 모델을 고민했습니다. 하지만 몇 가지 현실적인 문제와 부모님의 건강을 고려하여 최종적으로 6인용 카운터탑 모델을 선택하게 되었습니다.​■ 12인용 대신 6인용을 선택한 이유 (효도 가전의 포인트)​1. 설치의 편리함: 12인용은 싱크대 하부장을 완전히 들어내고 공사를 해야 한다는 점이 어머니께 큰 거부감으로 다가왔습니다. 주방 구조를 바꾸지 않고 조리대 위에 바로 올려 쓸 수 있는 카운터탑 방식이 훨씬 깔끔했습니다.​2. 고령자를 위한 인체공학적 설계: 12인용은 그릇을 넣고 뺄 때마다 허리를 깊숙이 숙여야 합니다. 무릎과 허리가 예전 같지 않으신 어르신들께는 이것조차 큰 부담이라는 이야기를 듣고, 서서 편하게 넣을 수 있는 높이의 6인용이 훨씬 적합하다고 판단했습니다.​■ 실제 크기와 사용성: 걱정보다 충분한 용량인터넷 후기에 6인용은 너무 작아서 냄비 하나 넣으면 끝난다는 소리가 많아 걱정을 꽤 했습니다. 그런데 실제 제품을 받아보니 생각보다 내부 설계가 효율적으로 되어 있어서 3~4인 가족의 한 끼 식사 분량은 충분히 소화합니다. 큰 냄비는 따로 닦더라도 매끼 쏟아져 나오는 수저와 밥그릇, 접시들만 해결되어도 어머니의 일손이 반 이상 줄어든 느낌입니다.​■ 사용 만족도 및 기능어머니께서 가장 만족해하시는 부분은 열풍 건조 기능입니다. 세척이 끝난 뒤 뜨거운 바람으로 물기를 싹 말려주니 그릇이 뽀송뽀송하고 살균되는 느낌이라 안심하고 사용하십니다. 비스포크 특유의 깔끔한 화이트 디자인 덕분에 주방 분위기도 환해졌고, 작동 방법이 복잡하지 않아 어머니도 금방 적응하셨습니다.​■ 장점​1. 허리를 숙이지 않고 서서 그릇을 수납할 수 있어 어르신들께 최적입니다.​2. 싱크대 개조 공사 없이 간편하게 설치할 수 있습니다.​3. 열풍 건조 기능 덕분에 위생적인 식기 관리가 가능합니다.​4. 주방 인테리어와 잘 어우러지는 세련된 디자인을 자랑합니다.​■ 아쉬운 점 및 고려 사항​1. 조리대 공간 일부를 차지한다는 점은 감안해야 합니다.​2. 아주 큰 프라이팬이나 곰솥 같은 대형 조리기구는 한 번에 넣기 어려울 수 있습니다.​■ 총평처음에는 너무 작지 않을까 걱정했지만, 실제로 써보니 가정의 평화를 가져다준 최고의 선택이었습니다. 특히 부모님 댁에 놓아드리는 경우라면 허리 건강을 위해서라도 무조건 6인용 카운터탑 모델을 추천하고 싶습니다. 어머니께서 설거지 걱정 없이 편하게 쉬시는 모습을 보니 진작 사드릴 걸 하는 생각이 드는 대만족 아이템입니다.#삼성전자이벤트참여

Since our household tends to produce a lot of dishes, I initially considered a 12-place setting built-in model, thinking that bigger was always better. However, considering several practical issues and my parents' health, I ultimately chose a 6-place setting countertop model. Reasons for choosing the 6-place setting instead of the 12 (Key Points of a Gift for Parents): 1. Ease of Installation: My mother was strongly opposed to the fact that the 12-place setting model requires completely removing the lower sink cabinets and undertaking renovations. The countertop style, which can be placed directly on the countertop without altering the kitchen layout, was much cleaner. 2. Ergonomic Design for the Elderly: With the 12-place setting, one must bend deeply at the waist every time dishes are loaded or removed. Hearing that even this is a significant burden for seniors whose knees and backs are not what they used to be, I determined that the 6-place setting, which allows for comfortable loading while standing, was much more suitable. Actual Size and Usability: Capacity is more sufficient than I feared. I was quite worried because many online reviews stated that the 6-person capacity was too small and would be full after just one pot. However, upon receiving the actual product, I found the internal design to be more efficient than expected, and it is sufficient to handle a single meal for a family of 3 to 4 people. Even if we wash large pots separately, just managing the spoons, bowls, and plates that pile up every meal makes me feel like my mother's workload has been cut in more than half. User Satisfaction and Features. The feature my mother is most satisfied with is the hot air drying function. Since it completely dries the water with hot air after washing, the dishes feel fluffy and sanitized, so she uses it with peace of mind. Thanks to the clean white design characteristic of Bespoke, the kitchen atmosphere has brightened up, and since the operation is not complicated, my mother adapted quickly. Pros. 1. It is ideal for the elderly as dishes can be stored while standing without bending over. 2. It can be installed easily without any sink renovation work. 3. The hot air drying function enables hygienic dish care. 4. It boasts a sophisticated design that blends well with kitchen interiors. Cons and Considerations. 1. You should keep in mind that it takes up some countertop space. 2. It may be difficult to fit large cooking utensils, such as very large frying pans or stockpots, all at once. Overall Review: At first, I was worried it might be too small, but after actually using it, it was the best choice that brought peace to my home. Especially if you are placing it in your parents' home, I would definitely recommend the 6-person countertop model for the sake of their back health. Seeing my mother relax comfortably without worrying about washing dishes makes me think I should have bought this for her sooner; it is a highly satisfying item. #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry
Comments (Original): ■ 구매 동기: 어머니의 설거지 해방을 위한 효도 선물평소 집안일 중 설거지가 가장 고되다고 하시는 어머니를 위해 식기세척기를 장만해 드리기로 했습니다. 저희 집이 그릇이 많이 나오는 편이라 처음에는 무조건 큰 게 좋다는 생각에 12인용 빌트인 모델을 고민했습니다. 하지만 몇 가지 현실적인 문제와 부모님의 건강을 고려하여 최종적으로 6인용 카운터탑 모델을 선택하게 되었습니다.​■ 12인용 대신 6인용을 선택한 이유 (효도 가전의 포인트)​1. 설치의 편리함: 12인용은 싱크대 하부장을 완전히 들어내고 공사를 해야 한다는 점이 어머니께 큰 거부감으로 다가왔습니다. 주방 구조를 바꾸지 않고 조리대 위에 바로 올려 쓸 수 있는 카운터탑 방식이 훨씬 깔끔했습니다.​2. 고령자를 위한 인체공학적 설계: 12인용은 그릇을 넣고 뺄 때마다 허리를 깊숙이 숙여야 합니다. 무릎과 허리가 예전 같지 않으신 어르신들께는 이것조차 큰 부담이라는 이야기를 듣고, 서서 편하게 넣을 수 있는 높이의 6인용이 훨씬 적합하다고 판단했습니다.​■ 실제 크기와 사용성: 걱정보다 충분한 용량인터넷 후기에 6인용은 너무 작아서 냄비 하나 넣으면 끝난다는 소리가 많아 걱정을 꽤 했습니다. 그런데 실제 제품을 받아보니 생각보다 내부 설계가 효율적으로 되어 있어서 3~4인 가족의 한 끼 식사 분량은 충분히 소화합니다. 큰 냄비는 따로 닦더라도 매끼 쏟아져 나오는 수저와 밥그릇, 접시들만 해결되어도 어머니의 일손이 반 이상 줄어든 느낌입니다.​■ 사용 만족도 및 기능어머니께서 가장 만족해하시는 부분은 열풍 건조 기능입니다. 세척이 끝난 뒤 뜨거운 바람으로 물기를 싹 말려주니 그릇이 뽀송뽀송하고 살균되는 느낌이라 안심하고 사용하십니다. 비스포크 특유의 깔끔한 화이트 디자인 덕분에 주방 분위기도 환해졌고, 작동 방법이 복잡하지 않아 어머니도 금방 적응하셨습니다.​■ 장점​1. 허리를 숙이지 않고 서서 그릇을 수납할 수 있어 어르신들께 최적입니다.​2. 싱크대 개조 공사 없이 간편하게 설치할 수 있습니다.​3. 열풍 건조 기능 덕분에 위생적인 식기 관리가 가능합니다.​4. 주방 인테리어와 잘 어우러지는 세련된 디자인을 자랑합니다.​■ 아쉬운 점 및 고려 사항​1. 조리대 공간 일부를 차지한다는 점은 감안해야 합니다.​2. 아주 큰 프라이팬이나 곰솥 같은 대형 조리기구는 한 번에 넣기 어려울 수 있습니다.​■ 총평처음에는 너무 작지 않을까 걱정했지만, 실제로 써보니 가정의 평화를 가져다준 최고의 선택이었습니다. 특히 부모님 댁에 놓아드리는 경우라면 허리 건강을 위해서라도 무조건 6인용 카운터탑 모델을 추천하고 싶습니다. 어머니께서 설거지 걱정 없이 편하게 쉬시는 모습을 보니 진작 사드릴 걸 하는 생각이 드는 대만족 아이템입니다.#삼성전자이벤트참여

Low Noise/Vibration: It's quiet enough that you can leave it on at night while you sleep without it bothering you (thanks to the inverter DD motor). Object Design: The matte texture and sophisticated colors (calming beige, nature green, etc.) blend seamlessly into your kitchen interior, providing a highly aesthetically pleasing experience. 2. Cons: Installation Restrictions: Built-in installations may require remodeling of the sink cabinet. This can be a stumbling block for those renting. Drying Performance Differences: While it has an automatic door-opening function, it takes quite a while to completely dry any remaining moisture in the backs of plastic containers or concave bowls. (The latest "hot air drying" model has improved this.) Washing Time: When set to "Standard" mode, it typically takes about 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours. While this takes significantly longer than hand-washing, the fact that "I don't do it" makes up for it.

Even hardened rice and greasy frying pans can be cleaned thoroughly with just a quick pre-wash. 100C True Steam: This is LG's biggest differentiator. Comments (Original): 1. 주요 장점 (Pros)​강력한 세척력 (토네이도 세척날개): 하단에 있는 X자 모양의 날개가 회전하며 강력한 물살을 쏴줍니다. 굳은 밥알이나 기름기가 많은 프라이팬도 애벌 설거지만 살짝 하면 아주 깨끗하게 닦입니다.​100°C 트루스팀: LG 식세기의 가장 큰 차별점입니다. 고온의 스팀으로 살균을 해주기 때문에 젖병 소독이 필요한 임산부/육아 가정에서 선호도가 매우 높습니다. 물얼룩(물때) 제거에도 효과적입니다.​자동 문 열림: 세척이 끝나면 문이 자동으로 살짝 열려 내부 습기와 냄새를 배출합니다. 자연 건조를 도와주어 냄새가 배는 것을 방지합니다.​저소음/저진동: 밤에 돌려놓고 잠을 자도 크게 거슬리지 않을 정도로 정숙합니다. (인버터 DD모터 덕분이죠.)​오브제 디자인: 주방 인테리어에 녹아드는 매트한 질감과 세련된 컬러(카밍 베이지, 네이처 그린 등)로 미적 만족감이 큽니다.​2. 아쉬운 점 (Cons)​설치 제약: 빌트인 설치 시 싱크대 하부장 공사(리폼)가 필요할 수 있습니다. 전월세 거주자의 경우 이 부분이 걸림돌이 되기도 합니다.​건조 성능의 개인차: 자동 문 열림 기능이 있지만, 플라스틱 용기나 오목한 그릇 뒷부분에 남은 물기까지 완벽하게 바짝 말리려면 시간이 꽤 걸립니다. (최신형인 '열풍 건조' 모델은 이 점이 개선되었습니다.)​세척 시간: '표준' 모드로 돌릴 경우 보통 1시간 30분~2시간 정도 소요됩니다. 손설거지보다 훨씬 오래 걸리지만, '내가 안 한다'는 점에서 상쇄되긴 합니다.
